title: Product Manager, Content Promotion and Distribution, Publishing & Fan Engagement
description:
#### **Job Requisition ID**


JR32766#### **Job Posting Date**


04\-03\-2025#### **Teams**


Product \& Design#### **Work Type**


Onsite
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.


As we grow globally, we have increasing opportunities to entertain and delight our members in new ways. As a Product Manager in Publishing and Fan Engagement, you will create technology to engage fans and the media with insider information about our content, power access to immersive experiences, distribute merchandise to global audiences, and execute creative marketing campaigns to drive engagement and conversation.


This role sits within the Content Promotion and Distribution organization which is at the intersection of the consumer experience and Netflix Studio. Our team is integral to making the Netflix experience feel personal and relevant by developing innovative approaches to how we promote, localize, and distribute content. Because our products impact both consumers and content creators, we seek someone who can fluidly move among both worlds, applying strong product principles and strategic frameworks, while deeply empathizing with the art and craft required to create great content.


This role can be based out of our Los Angeles, Los Gatos or New York offices in a hybrid model or remotely from the West Coast. Regular travel to our Los Angeles or Los Gatos offices will be required if remote or East Coast based.

**As a product manager at Netflix, you will:**

* Build a strategic roadmap and take product concepts from idea through validation, shipping, measurement, and iteration.
* Author strategy memos and presentations and represent your team’s work to senior executives.
* Lead a team of stunning colleagues across design, engineering, and data science to deliver outstanding products to our customers.
* Build business cases and measure the impact of your product innovation.
* Work alongside your design partners to deeply understand and socialize the evolving needs of our customers.
* Operate with true transparency and autonomy while consistently seeking feedback and input from partners to drive successful product outcomes. Our culture is unique and is key to how we innovate.

**The Role:**


We are looking for a Product Manager to advance our portfolio of products that drive conversation about our beloved titles. We give our members the opportunity to be immersed in some of the most beloved titles as they are brought to life in front of them at a Netflix House, an experiential entertainment venue. Or we help our members dive deeper into their favorite stories on Tudum.com \- Netflixs’ premier destination for members and fans to deepen their connections to their favorite titles and discover their next obsessions. Whatever the forum, our ultimate goal is to deliver a new way to experience Netflix and drive fandom by engaging with stories, characters, and talent, beyond the core Netflix experience. That’s where you come in. This role spans everything from the engaging digital experiences we offer to our members to the products that enable our marketing teams to bring each story to life.

**As a Product Manager in Publishing \& Fan Engagement, you will be responsible for:**

* Driving initiatives across a suite of products that deliver compelling digital experiences for consumers that keep them talking about Netflix.
* Driving initiatives that help our Marketing teams bring campaigns to life and grow our web properties.
* Partnering with the Publishing team who is responsible for engaging our members, fans, and the press with content across all Netflix editorial properties (Tudum, Queue, Written Comms, and Podcasting)
* Partnering with the Consumer Products team who is responsible for helping members and fans experience Netflix titles through physical touchpoints \- whether that be merchandise or experiences.

**Our wish list for the person in this role (remember, no one ever gets everything on their wish list!):**

* 5\+ years of Product Management experience with a proven record of prioritizing and successfully launching products or platforms
* Ability to inspire, motivate and lead a cross\-functional team \- your ability to build strong relationships is critical to success
* Experience working with creative teams and/or building products for creative teams (especially Marketing teams)
* Worked in a direct\-to\-consumer business, where the consumer is paying for the service
* Experience using data to inform priorities and evaluate impact of initiatives
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills \- you will write a lot!
* An ideal candidate is a highly motivated self\-starter with the ability to work independently and drive alignment amid ambiguity.
* Bias towards action, and can independently and effectively rally cross\-functional teams and drive projects forward with speed
* Embodies the Netflix values while also bringing a new perspective to improve our culture. We strongly believe that diversity of experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds will lead to a better environment for our employees and better products for our customers.


Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top\-of\-market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $120,000 \- $515,000\.


Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more detail about our Benefits here.


Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.


Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.


We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

We manage everything from onboarding to ongoing feed optimization, enabling our clients to scale faster with less effort.


Since 2014, Feedonomics has earned a strong reputation for our full\-service model, people\-first culture, and powerful technology—all rooted in a commitment to excellence.

The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge and expertise in online sales and advertising channels (e.g. e\-commerce platforms, marketplaces, search, affiliate). As a Senior Product Manager, you will drive strategic product initiatives, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and shape the future of our integration technology solutions to deliver exceptional value to our customers.

* Collaborate closely with other product managers, engineering, design, sales, and customer support teams to define product requirements and priorities based on market insights and business objectives
* Collaborate effectively to decompose intricate projects into smaller, more manageable tasks, progressively enhancing customer value with each iteration

* Collaborate closely with the Design team to create prototypes for new features

* Proven attention to detail to ensure accuracy
* Proven to be a self\-starter who can stay flexible and operate well in a changing environment and sometimes ambiguous environment

* Proven ability to balance strategic thinking with the urgency to drive work forward
* Proven ability to adapt quickly to changes in work direction and able to pivot work accordingly
* Proven to be a creative problem solver

title: Product Manager
description:
The product management team at Posit are responsible for the Posit commercial products (Workbench, Connect, Package Manager and Connect Cloud) as well as integration with our strategic cloud partners, such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Azure and GCP.



As a team we are responsible for the product vision and roadmap, specifically describing the rationale for product investment (what and why) and working closely with the development teams who build the product.



We also work very closely with the go\-to\-market teams, including product marketing, sales, customer success to ensure our customers are successful in their implementation of Posit products.



In this role you will work closely with the senior product managers on clearly scoped projects, where you will be responsible for product analysis and reporting, assist with product execution on the roadmap, and learn how to refine the product vision and strategy.


**You will own aspects of roadmap execution for specific Posit product features, including:**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


* Gathering and digestion of customer feedback.
* Authoring of product requirements documents outlining the WHAT and the WHY as well as appropriate scope.
* Attending sprint planning and reviews for refinement of a product feature through the software development lifecycle.
* Ensuring product documentation is correct and up to date, working with both the documentation and engineering teams
* Internal briefings and training (sales enablement) working with Product Marketing Management and Sales Operations

**In addition, you will be responsible for various product analyses and reporting, for example:**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


* Writing R or python scripts to query existing data (including feedback, call notes and closed/lost report) and make this available as reports or dashboard
* Speaking to internal voice of the customer (customer success, solutions engineering and support teams) to gather information about pain points and feedback for items on the roadmap
* Doing direct customer research by conducting structured customer interviews, typically with the data scientist or the system administrator
* Gathering market and competitive information on ideas and features in development
* Creating compelling demos of features that are imminent
* Writing technical blog posts for new feature releases

**You will assist the senior product managers with:**
-----------------------------------------------------


* Refining and triaging the backlog, through awareness of github issues (public as well as private repos)
* Refining product positioning, based on availability of product improvements and better knowledge of customer jobs\-to\-be\-done

**You will teach:**
-------------------


* You are familiar with data science tools and able to use Python or R to create dashboards and reports
* You have some proficiency in Linux and are able to install and manage server software. You are able to have conversations about security and scalability of enterprise software

**What you will learn:**
------------------------


**You will learn from the PM team how we approach product strategy:**
---------------------------------------------------------------------


* Refining the product vision, by matching product capabilities that match with jobs\-to\-be\-done
* Prioritizing new product opportunities, ideas and features, based on the combination of customer knowledge and Posit strategic needs
* Communicating this vision effectively to an internal audience (engineering, product marketing, sales enablement, etc.)
* Communicate this vision effectively externally, via blogs, analyst relations, conference talks, workshops, etc.

**Within 1 month, you’ll…**
---------------------------


* Meet the product management, product marketing, and engineering teams
* Create or update a Quarto report that reads data from the warehouse and publish this to our private Posit Connect instance
* Be able to navigate and query the product management system for feedback and idea tracking
* Start working on either Posit Workbench or Posit Connect:
	+ Become familiar with the software development lifecycle of the product you're working on, including shadowing a senior PM through release process activities.
	+ Participate in the ongoing product management activities, such as customer triage, engineering feedback sessions and release process activities.
* Create a personal on\-boarding plan

**Within 3 months, you’ll…**
----------------------------


* Have developed a good understanding of the end\-to\-end authoring and deployment workflow from Workbench to Connect, and can give a product demo of both products
* Have completed your first project on either Workbench or Connect, working closely with the senior PM
* Become responsible for the development of an active project workstream, including researching the what and why to write a Product Requirements document
* Contributed to the research and preparation for a future high\-priority project or opportunity not yet in development.
* Have contributed to the Posit blog on an existing feature or feature area.
* Have met with customers and partners to discuss your product

**Within 6 months, you’ll…**
----------------------------


* Have completed a review of a defined subsection product documentation, and have contributed a fix, interacting closely with the documentation team
* Have met with many members of the GTM team (Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Support)
* Continue to take responsibility for the support of product engineering projects as well as running point on the research required to prepare for future projects
* Be comfortable gathering feedback from end users and customers as well as presenting the product roadmap to customers.
* Regularly synthesize and communicate customer research findings to the larger product management group and engineering

**Within 12 months, you’ll…**
-----------------------------


* Join an on\-site team workweek as well as company work week
	+ (Posit is a remote only organisation, and we celebrate meeting in person about twice per year, but we accommodate remote attendance where possible.)
* Attend Posit Conf and actively participate in workshops, talks and customer conversations (we accommodate remote attendance)
* Develop an understanding of Posit current customer base by meeting with accounts across the spectrum of our tiles and verticals
* Contribute to the ongoing development of the 18\-mo product roadmap
* Present on portions of the 18\-mo product roadmap to stakeholders and engineering
* Be responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of numerous product enhancements
* Develop strong working relationships with engineering, design, product marketing, support, solutions engineering, and other product managers
* Complete your personal on\-boarding plan

description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description :

As a Data Product Manager you will play a crucial role in building and supporting the foundation of Enlyte's data\-driven decision\-making process as an early member of the Casualty Analytics Group. Your duties will include implementing data governance practices, analyzing insurance claim data, and driving data quality initiatives. **Key Responsibilities:*** Translate business requirements into product solutions
* Train business units on data schemas, analytical platforms, and visualization tools
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance our central databases with data integrity, additional features, and increased adoption
* Develop, implement, and maintain a data dictionary, processes and procedures, and governance playbook
* Drive understanding and adherence to the principles of data management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
* Enhance our central database and corporate analytical toolbelt to solve business problem use cases
* Conduct ad\-hoc analysis and support business teams in their analytical efforts
* Implement and oversee processes to ensure data integrity across the organization
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders to gain buy\-in for data initiatives


Qualifications:
* 3\+ years of experience in data management, analytics, or related roles
* Strong understanding of data governance principles and best practices
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences
* Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI
* Proficiency in SQL and basic understanding of programming concepts
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Demonstrated experience in implementing data quality processes and procedures

 **Preferred Skills:*** Degree in Business Analytics, Data Management, or a related field
* Experience with analytics platforms such as Hex
* Familiarity with big data technologies such as Snowflake
* Knowledge of the workers' compensation insurance industry
* Certifications in data management or project management (e.g., CDMP, PMP)

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. title: Product Manager, Certification Experience
description:
Want to help people learn the newest ways of working and getting things done?
  
  

As a Product Manager focused on Certification Experience, you will lead the strategy, development, and execution of our certification program experiences, ensuring they provide maximum value to our users seeking to upskill themselves with PMI certifications. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to enhance the certification experience, improve engagement, and drive conversions. In this role, you will define the long\-term vision for certification user experience, leveraging cutting\-edge learning technologies and market insights to create innovative and accessible certification experiences across all our certifications for professionals worldwide. Your work will ensure that our certification programs meet all industry standards, especially dealing with ANSI and ISO standards.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Define Strategy \& Vision: Develop and execute the roadmap for professional certification experiences, aligning with business objectives and market needs. Identify opportunities to enhance the certification user experience and increase application conversions.
* User Experience \& Engagement: Optimize the certification experience, ensuring seamless enrollment, onboarding, submission, credentialing, and verification processes. Implement user feedback loops to improve accessibility, engagement, and satisfaction.
* Technology \& Platform Enhancements: Work with engineering and design teams to improve platform functionality, integrations, and learner outcomes. Identify emerging technologies such as AI\-driven tools to enhance certification user experience.
* Data\-Driven Decision Making: Define key metrics, analyze user behavior, and leverage insights to refine product offerings and improve the certification experience. Conduct A/B testing and data analysis to continuously optimize certification performance.
* Market Research \& Competitive Analysis: Stay informed on trends in professional certifications, accreditation standards, and emerging learning technologies. Conduct competitive benchmarking and industry research to identify new opportunities.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with internal teams, including certifications, marketing, customer operations, technology, UX research to align strategies and drive success. Develop internal training and enablement programs to ensure teams are equipped to support certifications effectively.
* Regulatory Compliance \& Accreditation: Ensure that certification experience meets industry and legal standards, including accreditation requirements for ANSI and ISO where applicable. Work with compliance and legal teams to maintain credibility and trust in certifications.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**  

* 5\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3\+ years focused on certification, credentialing, or professional learning. Experience in the edtech or workforce development space is a plus.
* Strong understanding of learning technologies, assessment frameworks, and digital credentialing. Familiarity with platforms like LMS, LTI, or xAPI standards is a plus.
* Experience collaborating with accreditation bodies and certification authorities. Proven ability to establish and manage stakeholders.
* Proven ability to drive product adoption and optimize user engagement strategies. Experience with automation tools and AI based solutions to enhance application and user profile creation experiences is required.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and leadership skills. Ability to break down complex problems and develop scalable solutions.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders. Experience working in matrixed organizations or global teams is preferred.
* Experience with data analytics, A/B testing, and user research to inform product decisions. Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable strategies.
* Knowledge of compliance, accreditation, and credential verification processes is a strong advantage.

title: Product Manager, CourseGateway
description:
**Product Manager, CourseGateway**
* REMOTE: within the United States


*Candidates are required to be located in the United States*
**The Opportunity:**  

EDUCAUSE is seeking an experienced **Product Manager** to join its data analytics team. EDUCAUSE is an international nonprofit association whose mission is to advance higher education through technology innovation–equipping its community with the knowledge, resources, and community\-building opportunities needed to help shape strategic technology decisions at every level in higher education. This position is remote and reports to the Director, Decision Support.  

  

You are an excellent candidate for this role if you have used your understanding of market needs to manage the evolution of a web application or digital product through each phase of the product life cycle \- introduction, growth, maturity, and decline. You should have experience in digital product ideation, business requirement definition, business analysis, project management, and working with cross\-functional teams including marketing, end user support, and business development. You have an aptitude for identifying end\-user needs, building consensus, and defining business objectives.  

  

We encourage you to apply if you have experience that is transferable, even if it’s not a perfect match. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ\+ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.  

  

**Position Summary:**  

The Product Manager will oversee the development and continuous improvement of the CourseGateway.org platform that includes the CourseGateway.org website, product and courseware evaluation tools, and courseware evaluation content. Coursegateway.org is an initiative funded by the Bill \& Melinda Gates Foundation (BMGF) and this grant\-funded web application enables faculty and stakeholders at higher education institutions to discover and select courseware solutions for introductory college\-level courses designed to improve learning outcomes for Black, Latinx, Indigenous students, and poverty\-affected students.  

  

The Product Manager will evolve and translate CourseGateway’s multi\-year strategic roadmap into a tactical product roadmap and feature\-requirements that ensure the platform will be universally recognized as a leading independent source for awareness, discovery, and selection of high\-quality, equity\-oriented college\-level courseware and related services and resources. In this role, you will be managing platform development priorities and product release milestones along with organizing, and integrating feedback and sentiment data from key user groups including faculty, instructional designers, administrators, and courseware suppliers to inform the platform’s user experience and design.  

  

**Essential Responsibilities:**  

*Product Design and Enhancement*
* Develop and deliver on product roadmaps in close partnership with the director, internal stakeholders, and matrixed technical product team.
* Lead cross\-functional engagements with internal staff and higher education subject matter experts to define user personas, identify user needs, frame user requirements, and deliver decision\-support products.
* Identify, define, and coordinate the collection of relevant data elements needed to develop decision\-support products.
* Facilitate product design processes, including data visualization design, gathering community input, and UX validation.
* Scan competing and complementary products and conduct competitive market analyses to identify new risks and opportunities.

*Service Operations*
* Coordinate the work of internal staff and third\-party contractors to successfully produce decision\-support products, including the coordination and facilitation of regular product meetings and communications.
* Generate internal reports and stakeholder communications summarizing the results of product evaluations and the status of KPIs, outlining recommendations for product improvements.
* Collaborate with the EDUCAUSE technical team to establish and maintain development backlogs and plan work sprints.
* Train support staff on new and existing products; provide second\-level end\-user support as needed.

*Product Engagement*
* Assess KPIs, user inquiries, community discussion, and product evaluation information to develop and implement strategies for reaching engagement targets.
* With the EDUCAUSE marketing team, establish and execute marketing, promotion, and communication strategies, including leading ongoing improvements to our public\-facing web presence.
* Train end\-users on how to use EDUCAUSE decision\-support tools using a variety of channels including recorded video tutorials, webinars, virtual community meetings, and other outreach mechanisms.


  

*Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion*  

EDUCAUSE recognizes that the unique backgrounds, talents, skills, and contributions of every individual improve and enhance the quality of the organization. We believe creating an environment where everyone can belong, and thrive, is our collective responsibility.  

  

**Qualifications:**  

  

Education and Experience
* A Bachelors’ degree in product management, business, or related field and 5 years of working experience as a product manager, product owner, service owner, or business analyst ; or any combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the duties of the position.
* Digital product management experience preferred.
* At least 3 years of work experience in higher education IT or online education technology preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
* Demonstrated ability to establish, prioritize, and communicate business requirements.
* Experience with continual improvement methodology, product management, and agile project management.
* Demonstrated initiative with the ability to manage multiple short\-range and long\-term projects simultaneously
* Experience with developing interactive data visualizations based on user requirements using QlikSense, Tableau or other similar data visualization platforms, preferred
* Familiarity with survey platforms such as Alchemer, preferred
* Travel may be required to support EDUCAUSE conferences/events, research team operations, and external events relevant to the position.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $80,000 – $95,000 earned annually. This is a grant funded position through December 2023 with the possibility of funding renewal beyond that date. The pay range provided is EDUCAUSE's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this position. The actual salary will be based on non\-discriminatory factors such as depth and extent of relevant experience, education, training/certifications for preferred skills, and abilities. We ask for minimum salary requirements in our application to ensure we can meet candidate salary expectations; we do not base salaries on a candidate’s current compensation.  

  

EDUCAUSE’s compensation package also includes medical and dental insurance, employer\-paid life and disability insurance, 3 weeks paid vacation annually to start plus 6 days of personal time, paid holidays, professional development opportunities, and a retirement plan with generous employer matching.  

  

**About EDUCAUSE:**  

EDUCAUSE is a higher education technology association and the largest community of IT leaders and professionals committed to advancing higher education. We support those who lead, manage, deploy, and use information technology, helping them to anticipate and adapt to change, and advancing strategic IT decision making at every level within higher education. We bring together technology professionals and leaders across campus and the industry to solve today’s challenges.  

  

EDUCAUSE is committed to “uncommon thinking for the common good.” Being part of EDUCAUSE means being part of a community that accomplishes more together than they ever could on their own.

Therefore, we are committed to building a culture that attracts and sustains a diverse mix of people who are passionate about the work they do. We work to recruit, develop, and retain talented staff from a broad and diverse candidate pool.  

  

EDUCAUSE requires a background check for all potential employees.

Sr. Manager, Product Management(Remote)\- Capital One Software
Capital One has been a pioneer through our tech journey as the first large bank to go all in on the public cloud, while operating in a complex and highly regulated business environment. We have built out a large engineering organization, moved to the cloud, re\-architected our applications and data platforms, and embraced machine learning at scale. Our AI/ML capabilities are now at the forefront of what’s possible in banking. (e.g., Capital One Eno).

  

We are overcoming key data management challenges in the cloud related to data publishing, data consumption, data governance, and infrastructure management. To realize the full potential of our cloud and data strategy, we built new data management platforms in the cloud and solved new problems across the data ecosystem. Our teams have also built and battle tested new capabilities to meet those needs. We’ve open sourced several of the software tools we built (e.g., Cloud Custodian, Hygieia) and forged new partnerships with other digital leaders (e.g., Microsoft, MSFT).

  

Through this journey, we've developed a suite of internal solutions uniquely designed to meet the challenges of a digital\-first, cloud\-first business at scale. We also recognize that many other businesses are facing similar data management needs as they accelerate their cloud and data journeys, and are exploring how best to bring some of the tools to market as enterprise B2B software solutions.

  

Capital One Software is seeking a Senior Manager of Product Management who is passionate about marrying innovation with emerging technologies. As a Capital One Senior Manager of Product Management you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving a major transformation within Capital One.

 **Product Management**

  

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

  

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

  

Do you dream of more elegant and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? You have to ask yourself...do you feel like making an impact?

 **In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas:**

**Human Centered**

* You’ll lead sourcing and synthesis of customer discovery efforts to understand customer needs to drive the long term vision for your product
* You’ll turn these customer insights into actionable strategies that will define the priorities for your team and rally your stakeholders to your vision

**Business Focused**

* You’ll own and prioritize the long\-term (12\-18 months) product roadmap to deliver on business outcomes, working closely with a cross\-functional team to ensure that all the right resources are aligned to ensure that and your team will be successful
* You’ll define KPIs for your product and will be responsible for measuring and tracking to those measures, with an eye to adjusting and refining your roadmap as the data dictates

**Integrated Problem Solving**

* Develop and champion a bold vision that drives meaningful outcomes by embracing the art of the possible
* Build frameworks for complex decision making that enable effective debate and accelerate getting to the right answer

**Technology Driven**

* You’ll have an end\-to\-end understanding of your product and how it fits into the larger ecosystem to be able to anticipate impacts from changes in other parts of the business
* You’ll work closely with tech leadership and architecture to understand the tradeoffs of technical decisions and how they impact the ultimately customer experience your team will deliver always looking to ensure you’re using the best tool for the job

**Transformational Leadership**

* You’ll rally your teams and senior stakeholders to your product vision and proactively leverage relationships throughout the ecosystem to align to your vision and influence prioritization across partner teams
* You’ll be responsible for attracting and retaining top talent to your team and mentoring and developing associates on their product career

 **We want you if you are:**

 **Intellectually Curious.**

* You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.

 **Communicator \& Influencer.**

* You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you.

 **Do\-er.**

* You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work.

 **Passionate \& Customer Focus.**

* You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs.

**Learner.**

* You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help.
* Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long\-lasting relationships.

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
* At least 5 years of experience in digital product management

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering
* MBA or Master’s degree
* 3\+ years of experience in Agile product management
* Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

description:
**About the role:**
-------------------


As a Senior Product Manager of the Experience Team you will play a key role in shaping the future of the Going mobile app. Your focus will be on uncovering customer \& process pain points, testing hypotheses, and translating insights into actionable product strategies and experiences that drive material business impact in the form of new paying members.


You are ambitious, with a honed product intuition, eager to dig into the travel problem space understanding the unique position Going has as a subscription product. You invest the least to learn the most. You are able to identify major assumptions and risks up front in order to build clear hypotheses for iterative learning.


As a key player in shaping our product vision, you’ll not only own your roadmap, but you proactively share lessons learned with others, so that the mistakes we collectively make are only new ones.


We’re a remote first company, so to be successful, you are comfortable with ambiguity, autonomy, and thinking through complexity in a way that results in clear and concise outcomes to the cross functional organization.


You’ll work with a talented team of full stack engineering, design and analysts who expect you to use data and experimentation to guide your decisions, balancing risk\-taking with the need to deliver impactful results in short cycles. Aside from your direct squad you’re exceptionally comfortable thinking about the go to market application of your products, partnering with Marketing, PR and Member Success.


We have some ambitious goals, but that's never stopped someone like you (or us)!


This is a huge opportunity to join a special (we’re bootstrapped *and* profitable) company at a key inflection point to surpass our members’ expectations and take their experience to new heights.


This role will report to the VP of Product.

**What you bring to the table:**

* **Start\-up Mentality:** You have a track record of optimizing existing product lines, and/or building new, revenue\-generating ones from the ground\-up iteratively for consumer facing apps within a start\-up environment.
* **Ownership \& Accountability:** You do whatever it takes to move the team forward. You are laser focused on understanding, refining, and articulating the problem your team is solving, whether its big or small.
* **Go Deep:** When needed, you sweat the technical details, using them to enhance your strategic problem solving skills.

You are able to identify major assumptions and risks up front in order to build clear hypotheses for iterative learning.
* **Simplifying Complexity**: You value clarity over verboseness. You strive to be efficient in all ways, from your daily cross\-functional communication to the product experiences you bring to life.
* **Big Picture Thinking**: You are able to develop products that tie together member opportunities and what is most strategically sound for the business for the end to end product journey.
* **No Ego:** You work backwards from the business and customer goals, going where the data tells you to prioritize impactful outcomes. You don’t blur the lines between product intuition and personal biases.

**Must have's**:

* 3\+ years of consumer facing mobile app Product Management experience
* Comfortable in a start\-up environment and/or successfully launched 0\-1 products end\-to\-end
* Proven track record of providing impactful product solutions and making data\-driven decisions in the form of business performance outcomes

* Close working experience and collaboration with the following roles: Front End Engineers, Back End Engineer, UX/UI Design, and Marketing
* Ability to proactively think through complex problems and bring others along for the journey with concise communication and storytelling
* Roadmap approach that is highly adaptable to the greater business context and leading indicators
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and plan to work full\-time in the United States

**Nice to have's**:

* Strong understanding of the travel industry
* Subscription experience
* Proficiency with SQL

----------------------------------

* The salary for this role is $160,000 \+ equity
* 100% remote work environment
* Annual team retreats, with past destinations including Vancouver, Punta Cana, and Mexico City. We're heading to Washington DC this fall!

---------------


For over 30 years, CAF America has been a leader in enabling cross\-border giving to validated charities and charitable projects across the world totalling more than $1 billion. We enable our donors to make strategic, cost\-effective, and tax\-advantaged gifts through our vetted network of more than 1\.9 million charitable organizations in 135 countries, all while reducing the risk, reputation exposure, and administrative burden associated with cross\-border giving.  

At CAF America, we pride ourselves on creating a positive working environment and culture that values all team member’s experience and voices and represents the society we serve. **Summary:**
------------


The Product Manager is a new role designed to support and ensure CAF America’s products and services continue to meet the evolving needs of the U.S. philanthropic sector, with a particular focus on our core audiences of high net asset individuals, corporate and corporate foundations and social purpose organizations. Collaborating closely with CAF’s strong product team in the UK, this role focuses on staying informed about and serving as the internal subject matter expert on US market trends, analyzing client feedback, and leading product development to ensure our offerings remain current, adaptable, financially sustainable, and aligned with the expectations of our donors and charity partners.  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------


* **Market Insight \& Product Evolution**: Stay informed about the U.S. philanthropic landscape, including market trends, pricing, and audience needs. Lead smaller working groups across teams to identify challenges and opportunities for improving our products and services based on feedback from donors and charity partners.
* **Pricing \& Fee Structure Analysis** : Assess CAF America’s current pricing models and cost\-to\-serve analysis. Lead discussions on potential adjustments to fee structures, ensuring they align with market trends and organizational growth goals.
* **Client Relationships \& Feedback**: Survey select clients to assess satisfaction, uncover growth opportunities, and identify areas for product or service improvement. Analyze client feedback and industry trends to recommend enhancements and new product offerings.
* **Product Roadmap \& Strategy**: Lead the development of the product roadmap and annual product profiles, considering features specific to the U.S. market. Evaluate how systems and processes support and interact with our product offerings, ensuring alignment with the broader organizational strategy of a OneCAF.
* **Cross\-functional Collaboration**: Work closely with product leads, internal teams, and external clients to integrate feedback and develop actionable insights for product improvement. Collaborate with the UK Product team to incorporate U.S. market insights and ensure cross\-team alignment.
* **Product Performance \& Annual Review**: Monitor the performance of current products and services against established targets. Develop an annual product review that outlines performance, risks, areas for improvement, and potential new offerings. Maintain a list of potential features and tasks, ensuring they are organized and prioritized effectively.

* Strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills across cross\-functional teams.

* Self\-motivated, results\-driven, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About Planning Center**


Planning Center, established in 2006, has grown to support over 85,000 churches worldwide. As an independent company, we pride ourselves on being debt\-free with no outside investors. Churches use our tools to communicate and connect with their congregations, organize information, and coordinate events. We’re committed to building great products that solve real problems using web and mobile products.


Our team enjoys the flexibility of remote work, utilizing tools like Asana, Slack, Notion, and Zoom for collaboration. We gather quarterly at our main office in Carlsbad, CA, fostering our work relationships.

 **About the Work**


At Planning Center, the Product Marketing Manager connects *what* we build to *who* we serve. They possess expert knowledge about *how* our products fit into a competitive landscape and *why* our customers choose Planning Center.


Their experience in research, analysis, and positioning supports and informs the rest of the Marketing Team. As a result, they contribute to a set of marketing tactics that are targeted, incisive, compelling, empathetic, and effective. Through close collaboration with Product Managers, the Product Marketing Manager is ultimately responsible for driving successful go\-to\-market plans for new products and features as well as managing the full marketing lifecycle for assigned products/areas.

### **Responsibilities**

### **Go\-To\-Market Strategy \& Positioning**

* Develop go\-to\-market plans that successfully bring new products/features to market and distinguish Planning Center from its competitors.
* Establish, evolve, and champion go\-to\-market positioning and messaging for assigned products.
* Manage the full marketing lifecycle of all products, from launch to adoption, retention, expansion, amplification, and (occasional) sunsetting.

### **Research \& Competitive Analysis**

* Conduct research and analysis through interviews and surveys to gain meaningful insights about Planning Center customers and product use cases.
* Leverage research learnings to create personas that inform marketing tactics.
* Create and maintain competitor profiles that inform the Marketing and Product teams about the competitive landscape, including feature\-by\-feature comparisons, messaging analyses, and competitive strategies.

### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Product Managers to maintain alignment on product vision, positioning, and research findings.
* Participate in all relevant Product\- or Engineering\-led meetings to advocate for Marketing priorities and ensure alignment across teams.
* Work with the Director of Marketing, Product Managers, and company leadership to identify metrics that indicate a successful product lifecycle.
* Act as a product resource for other Marketing Team members as well as a marketing resource for Product team members.

### **Content \& Enablement Support**

* Support the Customer Success team with enablement resources (e.g., brochures, one\-pagers, slide decks).
* Create content strategies and support in content creation alongside Marketing and other departments, including email and ad copy, Planning Center University, and other areas as needed.
* Consult with the Director of Marketing and company leadership on PR\-related projects to provide customer insights and communications expertise.

### **Product Knowledge \& Advocacy**

* Maintain high\-level knowledge about all Planning Center products.

### **Who We Look For**

**You bring 3–5 years of product marketing experience in the B2B software space.**


Beyond your impressive background, you also bring the following:

* Educational background in business, marketing, communications, project management, or another related field, whether through a degree program, courses/certifications, or comparable job experience
* Robust understanding of customer retention and buyer psychology
* Ability to craft compelling, benefit\-oriented copy for digital and print marketing channels
* Experience conducting customer research, summarizing key learnings, and disseminating to internal stakeholders
* Comfort in customer\-facing contexts, including interviews, conferences, etc.
* Experience working cross\-departmentally with Support, Customer Success, Creative, Video, Product, and Engineering teams
* Experience developing, executing, and measuring go\-to\-market campaigns
* Proven ability to manage a complex software suite that includes multiple product lines
* Previous experience in a customer\-facing role (e.g., support, sales) is a plus


The best fits for any role on the Planning Center team are people embodying our **Core Values:**

* **Engage with Humility \-** We actively participate with openness and receptiveness. We are ready to listen, learn, and speak thoughtfully and kindly—regardless of skill level, expertise, or place on the org chart.
* **Invest in our team \-** We give our time and energy to our team’s success—improving collaboration with effective communication, making space for diverse perspectives, sharing knowledge, and asking questions.
* **Do Our Best Work \-** We aspire to do our best possible work—continually looking for ways to improve the quality of our individual output and contribute to our team's overall success and growth.
* **Focus on Customer Impact \-** We advocate for our customer’s best interests in our decision\-making—we can trace the goal of every project back to creating positive value for our customers.
* **Think Holistically, Work Iteratively \-** We focus on taking practical steps towards our goals with an awareness of the broader context—thinking big, working small.

  

We believe the strongest teams comprise people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, and we are committed to cultivating that diversity here at Planning Center. We're building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do your best work.

### **The Hiring Process**


During the hiring process, you’ll have a chance to interact with several members of our team. We strongly encourage you to bring any questions to anybody you interact with. You’re interviewing us as much as we’re interviewing you.

 **Applications will be accepted until 9AM PST on April 23, 2025\.**

  

Below is an outline of the steps in our hiring process.

* **Step one**: Apply with a resume, cover letter, and portfolio.
* + Your cover letter should speak directly to your interest in this position. We want to know what got you into product marketing, how your experience has set you up for success in this role, what motivates you to serve our specific customer base, and why you want to join our team.
	+ Your portfolio should highlight achievements in previous product marketing roles. We want to see specific examples of value added to your team, your products, and your customers. Your portfolio should demonstrate your grasp of go\-to\-market strategy, product positioning, and creative messaging. **Applicants without a cover letter and portfolio will not be considered.** Your portfolio can be attached along with your cover letter.
* **Step two**: A Blind Screen with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
* **Step three**: A discussion with the Director of Marketing and a member of the Marketing team to learn more about your background and approach.
* **Step four**: A series of Zoom interviews with key team members.
* **Step five:** Showcase your skills through a take\-home project.
* **Step six**: Review your assessment with the hiring manager and ask any final questions.
* **Step seven**: Pending all goes well, we'll extend an offer.

**Note for Internal Applicants:**

*We’re excited that you’re exploring new opportunities within our team. As part of our internal hiring process, we want to ensure transparency for all applicants. When you apply for a role on another team, your current manager will be notified. This is simply to ensure awareness and allow for any planning as needed.*

*Additionally, as an internal candidate, please be aware that some steps in the hiring process may vary slightly to better align with your existing familiarity with our organization. Rest assured, we aim to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation while maintaining a positive candidate experience.*

**Requirements**

* Reside in the United States
* Eligible to work in the United States (*we are currently* ***unable*** *to offer employment to those with H\-1B visas*)
* Be willing to travel four times each year to connect with the rest of the team (not during a pandemic)
* **3–5 years of product marketing experience in the B2B software space**

 **Benefits**


We love our team. It’s one of the core pillars we work off of every day, which is why we take care of you as best we can. Here are a few highlights, but you can find all our benefits here.

 **Get paid:** We pay competitive rates no matter where you live, contribute to your 401k, provide a charitable giving match of up to $2,000 a year, have a generous allowance for continued education, and offer a co\-working stipend. The annual salary range for this position is $105,000\- $145,000\.

 **Be healthy:** Generous paid sick time and vacation time, $200 a month for physical fitness and mental health, 95% medical \& 100% dental premium health coverage.

 **Get out:** Paid Fridays off in the summer, every other Friday off the rest of the year, a month\-long sabbatical every five years, one week off between Christmas \& New Year, one week off a year to serve with a globally\-focused non\-profit, and two weeks paid vacation a year increasing to three over time.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  

105,000 \- 145,000 USD per year(Remote)

title: Senior Product Manager, Core Foundations
description:
Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are hiring in Zones 2 and 3\. Please refer to our Compensation section below to see what neighborhoods fall under each Zone.
  
  

Company Description
  
  

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for more enlightened ways of working. We're a global community of more than 2,000 bold visionaries and resourceful doers who are shaping the future of Dropbox—and with it the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the flexibility of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, making space for both meaningful work and meaningful relationships. With our start\-up mindset and enterprise\-level opportunities, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. Here, you can own your impact to make work more intuitive, joyful, and human—for you as a Dropboxer and for hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you're ready to push boundaries—and yourself— Dropbox is ready for you.
  
  

Team Description
  
  

The Dropbox Product Management Team envisions and builds the future of work while growing our business, one product at a time. We're strategic thinkers and advocates for our users, crafting solutions that make work more intuitive and joyful. Using data, research, and strategy—and a healthy dose of empathy—we guide cross\-functional teams toward the shared goal of creating transformative products that people love to use. If you're passionate about building solutions that reshape how the world works while delighting users in the process, join our Product Management team.
  
  

Areas of work include Product Management, Product Strategy, User Research, Data Analytics, Product Operations, Growth Strategy, and Go\-to\-Market Planning.
  
  

Role Description
  
  

Join our team as a Senior Product Manager for Core Foundations, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the bedrock of our foundational user experience. Your collaboration with teams from engineering to design will be essential in crafting a product vision and strategy that not only meets today's needs but paves the way for future innovation. You'll have the unique opportunity to drive the evolution of Dropbox, refreshing essential features to bolster our growth and introduce new offerings.
  
Responsibilities
  
  

Develop a long\-term product vision that aligns with business goals and is informed by market trends. Translate customer feedback into actionable product milestones and assess competitor products to identify market opportunities. Create and maintain a product vision document to guide the development teams.
  
Benchmark industry best practices to inform strategic decisions and define key performance indicators that measure the success of these strategies. Ensure that product initiatives are in alignment with the company's overarching objectives.
  
Establish and maintain robust working relationships across engineering, design, and marketing teams to coordinate coherent product strategies. Integrate input from all stakeholders to refine the features and functions of our product.
  
Analyze existing user interactions to identify enhancement opportunities. Partner with design teams to refine the user interface and flow. Implement A/B testing to perfect features and gather user feedback through surveys, interviews, and usability studies. Work in collaboration with user experience researchers to gain insights into user behaviors.
  
Engage directly with customers to gather detailed feedback and gain a deep understanding of their primary needs. Use these insights to shape the product development process and always advocate for the customer perspective during team discussions. Keep a close eye on customer experience trends to guide product improvements.
  
Skillfully rank product features based on impact and effort to inform sprint planning. Balance the demands of stakeholders with user requirements and technical limitations. Allocate resources selectively to concentrate on high\-value initiatives and features. Lead cross\-functional teams in decomposing complex projects into actionable tasks.
  
Develop key performance metrics to gauge product performance and utilize data analysis for continuous improvement. Manage the execution of product initiatives, ensuring milestones and deliverables are met. Lead cross\-functional teams to achieve project goals within set timelines.
  
Requirements
  
  

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  
8\+ years in product management or related field
  
Proven ability to develop long\-term product visions and strategies
  
A deep understanding and empathy for end\-users — you love building products that make our customers feel joy, delight and trust
  
Impact driven and a consistent history of delivering measurable results for both users and the business
  
Build alignment and listen well, but can also drive hard decisions, framing the different options and tradeoffs
  
Ability to analyze and use quantitative and qualitative data to inform decisions
  
Strong communication, with an ability to influence with cross\-functional collaboration skills
  
Track record of launching and scaling successful products
  
Experience in leading cross\-functional teams to meet project goals and deadlines
  
Evidence of improving key product metrics and contributing to revenue growth
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  

Prior experience with SaaS companies, including their complexities, scale, and foundational technologies.
  
Strong data analytics skills to independently query for data, analyze it, and generate insights to inform product direction.
  
Compensation
  
US Zone 1
  
  

This role is not available in Zone 1 US Zone 2 $185,100—$250,500 USD US Zone 3 $164,600—$222,600 USD

Please note, OTE are for sales roles only.
  
  

Salary/OTE is just one component of Dropbox’s total rewards package. All regular employees are also eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Dropbox is committed to investing in the holistic health and wellbeing of all Dropboxers and their families. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

You are a self\-starter interested in working on a broad set of in\-house initiatives and taking on significant direct ownership responsibility.


The Growth Product Manager is responsible for working cross functionally and getting things done with the resources they have to drive P\&L results.

title: Product Management, Leader
description:

Our multidisciplinary product teams are creating new ways to help people connect, find communities and grow businesses. Together, we are committed to building innovative technologies — Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Workplace, Meta Quest and more — to serve billions of people around the globe.Meta Product Management Leaders work with cross\-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists and researchers to build products. We are looking for extremely entrepreneurial Product Management Leaders to help innovate and execute product initiatives across the company and value moving quickly. This job description represents different full\-time roles across our suite of products and platform.  

  

  

### **Product Management, Leader Responsibilities:**

* Lead a team through the ideation, technical development, and launch of innovative products
* Drive product development with a team of world\-class engineers and designers
* Attract, build, manage, and develop a talented team of product managers and product leaders with a broad range of experiences, perspectives, approaches, and backgrounds
* Establish shared vision across the company by building consensus on priorities leading to product execution
* Integrate usability studies, research and market analysis into product requirements to enhance user satisfaction
* Define and analyze metrics that inform the success of products
* Understand Meta's strategic and competitive position and deliver products that are recognized best in the industry
* Maximize efficiency in a constantly evolving environment where the process is fluid and innovative solutions are the norm

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in Product Management and/or Product Design
* 8\+ years of experience working collaboratively with engineering, design and user research teams
* Critical thinking/analytical leadership experience
* Experience presenting to executive audiences
* 6\+ years of experience hiring, managing, and developing both individual contributors and leaders
* BA/BS in Computer Science or related field

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in a consumer focused technology company
* Experience building 0\-1 products, platform/ecosystem products, or marketplaces

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Kentik is a fully remote company that operates globally. We seek professionals that will help us thrive as an organization, and in turn, to broaden and enhance your career. * Experience with the skill sets required for success
* Demonstrated competencies and potential
* A geographic market\-based approach

* Home office reimbursement
* Stock options

The true meaning of Kentik is **visibility**. We're committed to making sure everyone feels empowered to use their voice, has a sense of belonging, and is represented at Kentik.

With a competitive salary and amazing benefits on top of the meaningful and challenging projects you'll take on, we're sure you'll enjoy joining the Kentik team.

title: Senior Product Manager, Machine Learning Platform
description:
**About Upstart**



Upstart is the leading AI lending marketplace partnering with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit. By leveraging Upstart's AI marketplace, Upstart\-powered banks and credit unions can have higher approval rates and lower loss rates across races, ages, and genders, while simultaneously delivering the exceptional digital\-first lending experience their customers demand. More than 80% of borrowers are approved instantly, with zero documentation to upload.



Upstart is a digital\-first company, which means that most Upstarters live and work anywhere in the United States. However, we also have offices in San Mateo, California; Columbus, Ohio; and Austin, Texas.



Most Upstarters join us because they connect with our mission of enabling access to effortless credit based on true risk. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Upstart, we’d love to hear from you!


**The Team:**



Upstart’s **Machine Learning Platform** team is building a scalable, reliable, and user\-friendly ML Platform that enables our machine learning experts to quickly develop and deploy ML models in production. By building an exceptional platform for machine learning innovation, this team plays a crucial role in advancing Upstart’s core competitive advantage and accelerating our path to becoming the premier destination for consumer credit.



As the **Senior Product Manager, Machine Learning Platform** at Upstart, you will own the strategy and execution for the tools and services that enable data preparation, feature engineering, and model training workflows for our machine learning teams. You’ll collaborate with multiple engineering teams across machine learning platform engineering, software engineering, and data engineering to ensure the right data is made available to ML teams for offline research and accurately surfaced to models for online inference. You’ll drive improvements to the overall speed, cost, and efficiency of our training workflows, ultimately accelerating the speed by which ML teams can research, innovate, and ship new models into production. You’ll work across *all* machine learning teams at Upstart, spanning from customer acquisition to credit underwriting to fraud detection and beyond.

  


**How you’ll make an impact**


* Develop and execute strategies to (1\) make more data available and usable for ML research, (2\) accelerate model research \& development workflows, and (3\) deliver high\-quality, low\-latency model inference in production
* Establish and track success metrics to assess the impact of product initiatives, with a focus on ML efficiency/productivity, model and data quality, and online inference latency
* Make smart trade\-offs to inform the ongoing product roadmap, prioritizing the features with the highest ROI and experimenting when necessary
* Collaborate closely with product managers, engineering, analytics, machine learning, operations, and other key stakeholders to align goals and streamline processes, ensuring cross\-functional coordination and successful delivery of initiatives
* Leverage data\-driven insights to make informed product decisions, identifying opportunities for optimization and testing hypotheses to improve key metrics.

  


**Minimum Qualifications**


* 5\-10 years experience in a product management role focused on technical products or platforms

Experience building products that serve technical users (e.g. software developers, machine learning researchers, data scientists) * \- and a deep understanding of their needs and pain points
* Knowledge of machine learning workflows (e.g. model training, online inference, feature management, etc.)
* Ability to build relationships and effectively collaborate with all levels of the organization, from C\-level to individual contributors
* Ability to manage and influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus building

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with large scale machine learning platforms/infrastructure.
* Experience with large scale data platforms.
* Experience working with a machine learning team to ship models into production.

  


**What you'll love:**


* Competitive Compensation (base \+ bonus \& equity)
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart
* 401(k) with 100% company match up to $4,500 and immediate vesting and after\-tax savings
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Life and disability insurance
* Generous holiday, vacation, sick and safety leave
* Supportive parental, family care, and military leave programs
* Annual wellness, technology \& ergonomic reimbursement programs
* Social activities including team events and onsites, all\-company updates, employee resource groups (ERGs), and other interest groups such as book clubs, fitness, investing, and volunteering
* Catered lunches \+ snacks \& drinks when working in offices

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for ***\#BetterGlobalHealth***. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were \#19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024!

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR\-based data liberation platform.

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing ***\#BetterGlobalHealth*** to patients everyday!  

  

**Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!** **Summary:**
The Technical Product Manager (TPM) plays a pivotal role in translating market and client needs into technically sound product capabilities. This role leads the identification and closure of technical gaps between product and the broader healthcare ecosystem, working closely with architects, engineers, and delivery teams.
The TPM provides guidance throughout the product lifecycle—from early\-stage feasibility to design oversight and delivery—to ensure scalable, performant, and interoperable solutions with deep alignment to engineering and architecture. This role differs from a Group Product Manager in that it emphasizes **technical execution** over **strategic market positioning**, serving as the connective tissue between business requirements and technical implementation. The TPM is expected to engage directly in architecture discussions, reason about trade\-offs, and support the technical implementation end\-to\-end.
### **Primary Functions**

* Perform deep technical analysis to identify gaps between product and market/client needs, particularly in interoperability, performance, scalability, and standards compliance.
* Lead or support architecture and design discussions to ensure product features are technically feasible, secure, and align with long\-term platform strategy.
* Translate business requirements and client use cases into actionable technical specifications and requirements in collaboration with Product and Engineering.
* Participate in architecture and code review discussions to validate feasibility, scalability, and maintainability of proposed solutions
* Determine business and customer success metrics.
* Support backlog refinement and delivery oversight by providing technical context, architectural input, and prioritization guidance throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Evangelize product and/or features to both internal and external customers, hosting customer conversations and attending/presenting at relevant events.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and leaders in developing product communication materials (presentations, articles, white papers) and product sales strategies.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Architecture, Engineering, and Delivery to ensure high\-fidelity execution of the product roadmap.
* Guide customer conversations and solutioning discussions as needed to validate technical direction and clarify platform capabilities.
* Contribute to internal documentation and training to enable consistent understanding of technical workflows and decision rationale.
* Maintain deep, hands\-on knowledge of Clinical Intelligence product architecture, including technology stack, key integration points, and underlying system design..
* Develop and deliver product training to customer facing teams including product features and external demo requests for customers.
* Provide mentorship to all levels of Product Managers as well as support hiring and onboarding initiatives for new hires.
* Serve as a technical resource and decision\-maker to unblock delivery teams, balancing client requirements with architectural and operational considerations.
* Accountable for ensuring that all working hours are accurately reported in NetSuite on a daily or weekly basis, that the majority of (if not all) hours are tracked as billable and that the project management tool in NetSuite is properly and fully utilized.
* Tracking and reporting of billable hours is a critical aspect of project management and delivery to our customers and this is a major area of accountability.
* Comply with the privacy, security and confidentiality policies.

### **Prerequisites**

* 5\+ years of experience in a Technical Product Manager, Senior Business Analyst, Senior Product Owner, or related technical role in software product development.
* Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Health Informatics with a strong technical component, or a related field.
* Proven experience delivering complex software products or platforms, ideally in healthcare or enterprise environments.
* Strong familiarity with FHIR, SMART on FHIR, RESTful APIs, and system interoperability concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to review architecture/design proposals, translate use cases into technical requirements, and guide implementation discussions.
* Ability to read, write, and reason through code — enough to understand architecture proposals, review pull requests, or validate technical decisions.
* Demonstrated consultative experience including facilitating meetings and communications with executive\-level clients, prospects, and partners.
* Critical thinking skills with a creative solution\-oriented mindset.
* Self\-driven, proactive, and results\-oriented, with effective time management and communication skills.
* Familiar with the FHIR standard, SMART framework, and RESTful web services, strongly preferred.

**Some of the benefits we offer:*** Remote Work Environment
* Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days
* Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits
* RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution
* Life and Disability
* Employee Assistance Program
* FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning
* Super HAPI Fun Club

  

Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile.

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or military experience
* At least 2 years of product management experience or at least 3 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering
* 3\+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products
* 3\+ years of experience working on core product platforms powering digital experiences
* 3\+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process
