Senior Associate Product Manager\- Capital One Software(Remote)**Product Management\- Capital One Software**


Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.


We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.


Do you dream of well\-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

 **In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas****:**

**Human Centered**

* You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design
* You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

**Business Focused**

* Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis\-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs
* You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

**Technology Driven**

* You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology
* You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject\-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customers
* You’ll deliver well\-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

**Transformational Leadership**

* By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teams
* You’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

**We want you if you are:**

* **Intellectually Curious****.** You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges
* **Communicator \& Influencer.**You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you
* **Do\-er.**You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work
* **Passionate \& Customer Focus****.** You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs
* **Learner.** You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help
* **Team Player.**You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long\-lasting relationships

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or military experience
* At least 2 years of product management experience or at least 3 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering
* 3\+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products
* 3\+ years of experience working on core product platforms powering digital experiences
* 3\+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process

**Product Manager (Enterprise Storage Product Lifecycle)**
==========================================================


Remote \- United States


**Job category:** Marketing


**Job ID:** 129895\-en\_US


**Job summary**
---------------


The Enterprise Storage Business Unit (ESBU) Product Lifecycle Management Team (PLM) is responsible for launching and managing NetApp’s core ONTAP storage products. NetApp is looking for a Product Manager to join the PLM product management team and assume product line responsibilities, from launch through end\-of life. This role reports to the Director of Product Management, and he/she will work closely with the ESBU product leadership team and other cross\-functional teams to execute a compelling product strategy. This role requires that you have experience in managing enterprise storage products, including GTM activities related to launching products, tracking both business and product outcomes through the product lifecycle.


In this role, the Product Manager will be responsible for aspects of the products’ lifecycle, including positioning and pricing for launch, sales and partner enablement, through managing, and tracking adoption in the market. The role requires regular reporting to the BU leadership team, including business success metrics, impacts of technology and market trends, customers, and competitors.


To be successful in this role, you will have the ability to manage and influence all key stakeholders, including Engineering, Sales, Sales Operations, Pricing, Finance, Supply Chain, Support, and Marketing. The role also requires the ability to engage customers and partners through EBCs, roadmap updates, customer and partner events, and other feedback avenues.


The ideal candidate will also possess a technical understanding of hardware and software systems, enterprise storage ecosystems and solutions.

**Job requirements**
--------------------


Responsibilities:

* Managing technical and business aspects of a product line to ensure successful adoption and growth in the market.
* Communicate externally with customers, partners, and sales team to drive adoption and gather feedback.
* Track, manage, and report on success metrics associated with the product line.
* Communicate product line performance to senior leadership through regular business reporting.
* Manage operational aspects, like pricing, quoting, forecasting, and end\-of\-life planning.
* Work cross\-functionally with stakeholders within the PM team and across the organization.


Capabilities:

* Ability and aptitude to develop solid understanding of NetApp’s product portfolio, market segments, value propositions.
* Excellent communication, collateral creation, organization, and execution skills
* Ability to consolidate information from a variety of resources, including (but not limited to) usage data, customer feedback, and market analysis, to create strategies for market growth.
* Builds strong connections and works cohesively with internal and external stakeholders.
**Education**
-------------

* 3\-4 years of prior experience of working in Enterprise Software or the IT infrastructure space in the following roles: Product Management, Customer Success Engineering, Solutions Engineering
* Ability to work with and influence cross\-functional stakeholders within the BU and Field organizations.
* Self\-motivated, process driven, biased toward action, capable of defining objectives and delivering workstreams from start to finish.

Compensation:  

The target salary range for this position is 121,125 \- 180,290 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off (PTO), various Leave options, Performance\-Based Incentives, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s), with all offerings subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. Benefits may vary by country and region, and further details will be provided as part of the recruitment process.

title: Sr Product Owner (Remote)
description:
**Flexible Work Policy: The work for the Sr Product Owner position is completely 100% remote anywhere in the United States except Hawaii or United States Territories. This position may have the potential to travel up to 25% dependent on business needs.**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**  

* Establish and maintain relationships with business and technology stakeholders to drive Product strategy and prioritization decisions
* Serve as a liaison between the business and development, acting as the voice of the customer and communicating requirements and needs to the Product team
* Deliver on\-time, on\-budget, on\-quality, on\-fit service(s) or Product(s)
* Own, maintain, and continuously groom the Team Backlog
* Facilitate delivery of features along with the Scrum Master by refining and improving processes that lead to more efficient development cycles
* Drive the engagement and delivery of Business Analysts and other Product Owners within the given Product ecosystem (may vary per team)
* Work within an Agile framework to develop and execute against a Product roadmap
* Develop user stories with detailed requirements and acceptance criteria that address end\-user needs
* Participate in recurring Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Demos, etc.
* Establish and maintain metrics that track value of delivered Features and team output
* Ensure consistent delivery of value to the end\-user through strategic prioritization and efficient delivery
* Manage upgrades and ensure Product or Product elements are up to date in order to avoid technical debt
* Primary responsibility for Product team operations, including financial management and resourcing (varies by team)
* Maintain an innovating and future\-proofing agenda for given Product(s)
* Develop a deep understanding of the business functions we serve and possess strong business acumen
* Other duties as assigned by manager


  

**SUPERVISION:**  

* Depending on the individual team construct the Sr. Product Owner may have formal people management / reporting responsibilities, including but not limited to the supervision of Grade 15 Product Owners and/or Business Analysts


  

**RELATIONSHIPS**  

* Internal: Business Stakeholders and End Users, IT Leadership, IT Delivery (Scrum Masters, Developers, Architects, UX Designers, Program Managers, etc.)
* External: Application / Systems Vendors (as applicable)


  

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**  

* Up to 25% travel
 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**  

* 7\+ years demonstrated experience in Product Ownership / Product Management, Business Consulting, IT Business Analysis, or another related field


  

**Education**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Information Systems, or equivalent work experience

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**  

* Agile or SAFe certification(s) highly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to influence change within large, complex organizations

title: Senior Product Operations Manager, Remote
description:
Aledade’s Product \& Technology organization has grown significantly over the past 3\-5 years and is responsible for increasingly complex, high\-value products that require processes and tools to enable more efficient \& consistent delivery.  

As a Senior Product Operations Manager, you will be a key contributor in defining a common product development process (inclusive of Agile principles and methodologies), facilitating change management to bring the product and technology organization on board, and supporting the organization in continuing to evolve. Your primary focus will be to support the transformation efforts, ensuring that Agile practices are effectively implemented to optimize productivity, foster collaboration, and promote innovation.  

You will work closely with the broader product and technology division, as well as with the leadership team. You will aid in the development and execution of a comprehensive Agile transformation implementation plan, aligned with Product \& Technology’s objectives, emphasizing transparency and continuous improvement, and striking a balance between standard Agile practices and the unique characteristics of Aledade, ensuring the transformation strategy is fit\-to\-purpose and aligned with our culture \& unique business needs. You will also support organizational planning efforts by overseeing quarterly planning retreats for Product, Technology, and Analytics.  


### **Primary Duties:**

* Collaborate with leaders and team members to define and support standardization of processes and tools to enable Product \& Technology to work more efficiently \& effectively across teams and with the business.
* Lead change management strategies, including conducting training workshops and providing individualized coaching to teams to identify challenges and encourage the adoption of Agile practices, while offering guidance on effectively utilizing tools like Jira and Confluence in conjunction with team Agile methods.
* Oversee quarterly planning retreats for Product, Technology, and Analytics, including identifying strategic groupings, establishing planning milestones, coordinating the event and setting the agenda as well as optimizing the overall planning process and tools.
* Assist with facilitation of our Product community of practice, fostering a culture of growth and building relationships across teams.
* Contribute to the development of internal documentation and proactively seek opportunities to improve onboarding processes and enhance educational resources.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years experience with product development processes at a SaaS company/organization with proven outcomes in product development, technology operations or program management.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline

### **Preferred Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities:**

* Strong understanding of various Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, etc.) and their practical application in diverse business contexts
* Experienced in relevant collaboration \& product management tools such as Google Workspace Atlassian (incl Jira and Confluence), Monday
* Proven ability to address resistance and challenges related to Agile adoption with a positive, solution\-oriented approach
* Strong strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities, balancing short\-term goals with long\-term Agile transformation objectives
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels
* Certification as a SPC (SAFe Program Consultant), Enterprise Agile Coaching (ICP\-ENT) Certification, Certified Scrum Professional (CSP), or other relevant Agile certifications are desirable
* Proven experience in a large scale transformation effort
* Both start up as well as large enterprise experience

**Who We Are:**
Aledade, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape \- independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country \- helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value\-based care. Additionally, by creating value\-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee\-for\-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best \- keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society \- and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote\-first culture \- you've come to the right place. **What Does This Mean for You?**
At Aledade, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open\-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work \- and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.  

In addition to time off to support work\-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well\-being of our team members:  

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time\-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more! *At Aledade, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.*

title: Senior Product Manager, Guide
description:
At Included Health, our mission is to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone. The healthcare system is confusing, complex, fragmented, and the decisions are high\-stakes. On the Guide team, it’s our job to take the work out of getting our members to the right care. We are looking for a Product Manager who can help solve some of the biggest pain points in the healthcare experience – from how patients figure out what care might cost, to understanding how their health insurance works, to ensuring they are able to afford their medications. This is a role that will focus on some of the most common and highest\-friction experiences in healthcare, and has an opportunity to impact the lives of our millions of members.  

In this role, you’ll be solving challenging problems such as:* How do we get members on the right medication at the right price? How do we ensure that affordability isn’t a barrier to adherence? How do we help them get help when they experience side effects or problems with their medications?
* How do we make it easy for members to understand how health insurance plans work and what they cover?
* How do we help members understand the cost of care? How do we give them a path forward if the cost is too high for them?
* How do we help members understand their healthcare bills? How do we provide advocacy for them when they’re billed incorrectly?

  

You’ll be solving these problems through both our self\-serve digital experience and via human\-powered services you’ll support in partnership with our care team. Within Included Health, solving these problems successfully means meaningfully increasing healthcare access and affordability for millions of members, while also scaling our business to support many millions more.
### **As a Senior Product Manager, you will:**

* Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and prioritization for both existing and yet\-to\-be\-developed products and features.
* Work closely with design, engineering, data science, clinicians, and other cross\-functional partners to prioritize features and ship products across the full product lifecycle from idea, research, design, specification, metrics definition, development, launch and beyond.
* Understand and analyze user/customer needs deeply using both quantitative and qualitative tactics.
* Partner with go\-to\-market teams to design and prioritize solutions that simultaneously address member problems, increase healthcare access, and reduce costs for members and customers.
* Create and implement measures to help quantify and optimize the impact on members and customers. Use these measures to help the team prioritize their work.
* Develop expertise in how the healthcare system works and become an authority both internally and to customers for how to tackle key problems members face.
* Collaborate with other product managers to deliver cohesive, robust experiences.
* Transform the way that millions of people experience healthcare

### **You might be a good fit if…**

* You have 5\+ years of experience as a Product Manager
* You’re comfortable using a combination of data, user research, and market research to deeply understand problems and generate insights that point towards differentiated solutions
* You have successfully pitched a new product or business to your company, resulting in increased revenue / scale / impact
* You know how to get the most creative thinking out of yourself and others in order to push the needle of what is possible
* You have strong product sense – you know what makes products great and why those things work
* You love understanding complex systems (such as healthcare!) and aren’t afraid of going deep to build expertise
* You make it a habit to define success for your products quantitatively, and using data\-driven experimentation in order to iterate your way towards those success criteria.
* You’re equally comfortable sketching out design ideas to illustrate an idea, writing SQL queries in order to understand your product better, and putting together a business case for a CEO.
* You have deep empathy for users, and keep the patient and their needs at the center of the product.
* You possess excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills.
* You have previous experience building products for consumers (healthcare experience is not required!)
* You believe that the way that people receive healthcare can and should be better.

### **Physical and Cognitive Requirements:**

* Prompt and regular attendance at assigned work location
* Ability to remain seated in a stationary position for prolonged periods
* Requires eye\-hand coordination and manual dexterity sufficient to operate keyboard, computer and other office\-related equipment
* No heavy lifting is expected, though occasional exertion of about 20 lbs. of force (e.g., lifting a computer / laptop) may be required
* Ability to interact with leadership, employees, and members in an appropriate manner

Zone B: $140,943 \- $199,089 \+ equity \+ benefits

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About us:**



Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that's gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested $1\.9 billion in real dreams and real opportunities, spanning more than 90 countries and 4\.7 million borrowers.



As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values\-driven and digital\-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130\+ full\-time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva's team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.


#### **Kiva's values:**



Impact first \- This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.



Extreme ownership \- Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.



Be curious and bold \- Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.



Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. \- Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.



Honor and integrity \- Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.



Love and kindness always \- Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.


**Role overview:**



Kiva's growth and impact goals are lofty and our operations are complex. As a product manager at Kiva you'll be responsible for leading initiatives that affect lenders, borrowers and Kiva staff around the world. The work is challenging and satisfying and we are seeking someone who is passionate about the Kiva mission and has a track\-record of building great consumer facing products.



Over the past 12 months, Kiva product managers have worked on a wide range of highly impactful projects, including:


* Building a successful revamped product for corporate partners.
* Introducing gamification to motivate lenders to lend more and understand how their lending fits into solving global issues.
* Researching, designing, and shipping an improved borrower application and dashboard experience in order to increase the success rate for fundraising and repaying their loans.
* Building an intuitive and motivating tool for the people who endorse and recruit US borrowers.

The next 12 months will see us tackling even bigger, more innovative projects as Kiva looks to expand the scope of our offerings in our mission to solve the most pressing global issues. Because of this, we are looking for an exceptional senior product manager to join the team. This role will involve a great deal of coordination and collaboration with teams across the org and needs someone with impressive leadership, operational, product, technical and marketing skills.



At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full\-time basis; unfortunately we cannot provide visa sponsorship.


**Key responsibilities include:**


* Shape the product roadmap by understanding the needs and impact of various users/customers and identifying the most promising initiatives.
* Work with the engineering, design, and marketing teams to deliver new features, product enhancements, and delightful user experiences.


	+ Lead the research / business requirements gathering phase.
	+ Write user stories / product requirements and create Jira tickets for projects.
	+ Work with our designers to create wireframes, mockups, and prototypes.
	+ Conduct user research and usability testing.
	+ Own projects through the full project lifecycle (ideation through launch).
* Work closely with technical teams (including QA) as they release features in an Agile 2\-week iteration process.
* Be responsible for ensuring the smooth rollout of new features and the continued quality and performance of existing products.


	+ Define, measure and analyze metrics. You will own the numbers and make sure that we are looking at the most important data.
	+ Define and set\-up a/b tests to optimize the site.
* Triage new feature requests.
* Serve as the voice of the user and ensure that we are correctly balancing the needs of our lenders, borrowers, and the Kiva organization.

**Preferred qualifications:**


* Experience delivering outstanding consumer internet products.
* Empathy for users and a great instinct for what makes good design / UX.
* Strong execution orientation; proven ability to deliver quality projects that satisfy and delight customers.
* Experience in an agile software development environment, with rapid feedback loops and quick release cycles.
* You work well in a collaborative environment and are admired by your colleagues for your ability to balance the needs of multiple customers.
* Self\-starter and leader. Someone who is able to work through uncertainty to identify promising product opportunities and drive them to launch.
* A great communicator (verbal and written). You are able to energize and rally your cross\-functional peers to row in the same direction.
* Passionate about Kiva and its long term potential.
* 5\-8 years in a product management / product marketing role for a consumer facing and/or fintech and/or CSR website.

**What we offer:**


* An opportunity to improve real lives, solve hard problems, and change the world.
* A friendly, supportive, and adventurous environment with a team of engaged colleagues.
* A comprehensive, industry\-leading benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, professional development, 401k matching, and generous PTO. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by Kiva.
* Opportunities to connect with and learn from colleagues and partners around the world.
* Salary range: $116K \- $173K; a final offer will be dependent upon a candidate's location, skills, and experience.
* Please note that we are **not** currently open to work\-from\-home employees residing in the following states: AL, AK, DE, HI, IN, KY, MS, MO, NE, NM, ND, OK, RI, SC, SD, VT, WV, WI, and WY.

*A diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is an integral part of Kiva's culture. We actively welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a great place to work. Join us and help us achieve our mission!*



We will only accept applications directly from candidates. Kiva will not be responsible for any recruiting agency fees, absent a formal agreement.

title: [REMOTE] Sr. Product Portfolio Manager
description:
**Join a High\-Performance Startup Focused on Building the Future of AI\-Driven Paid Acquisition Performance Marketing**


At **WKND**, we don't just follow trends—we create them. As a fast\-paced, tech\-forward startup (backed by **WKND Investments**), our mission is to transform how global DTC brands acquire and retain customers through AI\-powered performance marketing. Whether launching innovative campaigns or building strategy for scalable SaaS products, we move quickly, solve complex challenges, and deliver world\-class results. If you thrive on innovation, excellence, and speed—and want to shape the future of **AI\-driven** growth—you belong at WKND.


**Our Core Values**
-------------------


* **Relentless Pursuit of Excellence**  

At WKND investments, excellence isn't optional—it's our standard. We've cultivated a performance\-first culture where outcomes reign supreme—whether launching high\-performing campaigns in record time or leveraging AI to solve complex marketing challenges.
* **Innovation at Speed**  

By harnessing **advanced AI and automation**, we redefine performance marketing. Rapid experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement are in our DNA.
* **Uncompromising Standards**  

We act with a founder's mentality—taking ownership of our work, scaling solutions without unnecessary complexity, and executing with precision.
* **Customer\-Centric Mission**  

We obsess over delivering powerful, measurable results that help DTC brands attract, convert, and retain customers at scale.
* **Visionary Thinking**  

We anticipate where marketing is going tomorrow. Join us in pioneering the next decade of eCommerce growth, driven by AI, automation, and data.
* **The Power of Communication**  

We believe in proactive, transparent communication—sharing insights, challenges, and wins early and often. As a consultative expert, you'll offer thoughtful recommendations that serve both short\-term impact and long\-term goals. This open dialogue and empathy enable us to build strong relationships, deliver world\-class outcomes, and maintain a culture of speed, accountability, and innovation.


**Why Join WKND?**
------------------


* **Build Innovative SaaS Solutions**: Shape, test, and scale products that revolutionize eCommerce growth.
* **Solve Mission\-Critical Challenges**: Leverage AI\-powered marketing and data analytics to help brands maximize ROI and profitability.
* **Pace of Innovation**: Operate at the cutting edge of technology—where **bold thinking** is rewarded and your ideas can quickly become reality.
* **Performance\-Based Rewards**: Earn top\-tier compensation, stock options, and bonuses aligned directly with company growth and **your** contributions.
* **High\-Performance Culture**: Become part of a collaborative, fast\-moving team that values real impact over empty effort.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


As the **Senior Product Portfolio Manager** at WKND Investments, you will spearhead the strategic vision and hands\-on execution of our diverse product and client portfolio, serving as a key driver in shaping product (partner) roadmaps, cultivating deep client relationships, and coordinating cross\-functional teams to deliver exceptional outcomes. From AI\-driven innovations to client journey strategy and execution and executive positioning, every initiative will align with our mission to push the boundaries of performance marketing and achieve profitable, data\-driven outcomes.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **1\. Product \& Portfolio Leadership**


* **Product Vision \& Roadmap**: Define and communicate a clear vision for WKND's product suite, prioritizing features based on data\-driven insights and client needs.
* **Portfolio Strategy \& Growth**: Oversee a portfolio of client accounts and digital products, identifying cross\-product synergies to drive both revenue growth, retention and enhanced brand loyalty.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination**: Collaborate with design, UX, development, marketing, and analytics teams to ensure seamless execution. Align on project goals, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Land\-and\-Expand Architecture**: Design entry\-level solutions and complementary add\-on modules, ensuring clients can seamlessly adopt new products over time.


### **2\. Client Engagement \& Delivery**


* **Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication**: Build strategic client relationships through regular updates, event planning, and thoughtful communication strategies. Serve as the primary point of contact for product features, updates, and positioning.
* **Project \& Campaign Oversight**: Manage multiple high\-complexity initiatives from start to finish—resolving roadblocks proactively, adjusting resources, and ensuring each “land” paves the way for eventual “expand.”
* **Performance Reporting**: Own client reporting dashboards and interpret key metrics (KPIs, ROI, growth) to deliver actionable insights. Present data\-backed recommendations that elevate portfolio performance and demonstrate how additional product/service adoption or specific campaign initiatives increase profitable outcomes.
* **Land\-and\-Expand Mindset**: You're adept at uncovering opportunities to grow client partnerships, from initial adoption to multi\-product/service usage, increasing lifetime value and retention.


**3\. Financial \& Operational Management**


* **Budget \& Resource Allocation**: Develop and manage budgets for both client campaigns and internal product initiatives, ensuring projects remain within financial targets.
* **Negotiation \& Contract Management**: Secure profitable agreements, balancing the client's goals with WKND's strategic and financial objectives. This includes structuring multi\-stage pricing, bundle packages, or expansion clauses that align client goals with WKND's long\-term strategy.
* **Process Optimization**: Continuously refine workflows to streamline onboarding for new products/services, ensuring expansions are operationally efficient and scalable.


### **4\. Strategic Growth \& Innovation**


* **AI\-Driven Experimentation**: Champion rapid experimentation with AI and automation across product roadmaps and marketing strategies to stay on the leading edge.
* **Thought Leadership \& Vision**: Anticipate emerging industry trends, shaping high\-level initiatives that **future\-proof** our offerings.
* **Data\-Backed Storytelling**: Translate complex analytics and market data into compelling narratives for both technical and non\-technical audiences, aligning internal/external incentives and motivations while highlighting the value of adding or upgrading products/services within our portfolio.


**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* **Experience**: 5\+ years in product management, portfolio/program management, or business development within a fast\-paced, digital environment.
* **Leadership \& Collaboration**: Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams, guide change management, and achieve consensus among diverse stakeholders.
* **Client \& Stakeholder Engagement**: Track record of creating high\-impact communication strategies (e.g., executive briefings, conferences, marketing events) that nurture strong client relationships.
* **Analytical \& Technical Acumen**: Skilled in data interpretation using tools like Excel, Google Analytics, or equivalent. Comfortable navigating discussions on product features, technical dependencies, and market trends.
* **Adaptability \& Innovation**: Thrive under pressure, embrace ambiguity, and consistently push the boundaries of what's possible—particularly when designing and iterating on land\-and\-expand initiatives.


**Who You Are**
---------------


* **AI\-Driven Innovator**: You're passionate about leveraging AI and automation to push the limits of what's possible, always looking for ways to deliver scalable, cutting\-edge solutions that drive success.
* **Strategic Communication**: Present complex ideas with clarity and persuasion, tailoring your message to different audiences (technical teams, executive leaders, and external clients)

description:
College Board – AP\&I
100% Remote, working core EST hours (anticipated travel 5\-6 times per year, usually 1\-2 days at a time)
About the Team
The Digital Transformation team is committed to making higher education accessible to every student. You'll leverage your strong background in product management and your knowledge of educational technology to create a compelling vision and maintain a strategic roadmap for the Digital SAT Suite of Assessments based on market trends, customer needs, and organizational priorities. You are eager to solicit and analyze feedback from our diverse set of stakeholders, including state and district partners, schools, students and internal College Board teams such as customer service and research, turning insights into impactful actions. In the face of complexity, you lean in with initiative, demonstrating leadership and influence to align teams and deliver results that matter.*In this role, you will:*

* Align product strategy with program goals, while deeply understanding customer needs and validating solutions through data and feedback

* Establish and maintain a deep understanding of the market including the competitive landscape, emerging trends, customer needs and market requirements
* Review market data and user feedback consistently to shape the product roadmap and improve user experience
* Lead new product and feature development by developing compelling business cases and rationale for new product investments

* Communicate timely product updates to internal and external stakeholders, including district and state partners
* Represent College Board’s digital testing platform as a subject matter expert in state and district customer meetings
* Work cross\-functionally to identify and implement enhancements to product implementation processes, program policies, and operational support models


About You*You have:** 5\+ years of experience in Product Management, with recent and substantial experience in educational technology
* Experience in K\-12 digital assessment delivery is a strong plus
* A proactive, ownership\-driven mindset; you’re the opposite of a passive ”go\-between”\-you drive solutions, not just messages
* Hands\-on experience working in an Agile product development environment, collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams
* A customer\-centric approach combined with strong organizational awareness; you’re curious and adaptable with tremendous learning agility
* Strong analytical skills, using both quantitative data and qualitative insights to define problems and develop effective solutions
* A proven track record of building trusted, productive relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences
* The ability to travel 5\-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business
* Authorization to work in the U.S.

When you join Ancestry, you join a human\-centered company where every person’s story is important. With our unparalleled collection of more than 40 billion records, over 3 million subscribers and over 23 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Ancestry is seeking a Staff Product Manager for Search Experience to shape the product strategy, roadmap, and implementation of Ancestry’s Search offerings. Search is a core experience of Ancestry’s Family History products, empowering users to explore our extensive data and uncover their ancestors' stories. In this role, you will collaborate with diverse teams including data science, search engineering, marketing, customer support, content, and legal to enhance and refine the search experience for all users. You will establish metrics, spearhead the creation of innovative algorithms, and design interfaces that showcase the most valuable content Ancestry provides. Your vision will be validated through rapid prototyping, effectiveness measurement, and cross\-organizational collaboration to bring it to fruition.

**What you will do:**

* Develop and articulate the strategy and vision for our search experience, grounded in a comprehensive understanding of customer needs, Ancestry’s rich content assets, the product landscape, and industry trends. Translate this strategy into a detailed roadmap and oversee its successful execution.
* Oversee the entire search experience, collaborating with specialists in machine learning and search ranking within Engineering, Data Science, and Design to devise innovative solutions that address real business challenges by harnessing the capabilities of Data, AI, and ML.
* Address complex and challenging problems that are crucial to how users search and discover Ancestry’s content, aiming to create a leading industry experience.
* Collaborate with colleagues to transform your strategic vision into a globally scalable product. This includes taking into account local customer needs, cultural nuances, and competitive landscapes to foster business growth and maintain our loyal customer base, while also meeting the needs of new users.
* Work closely with UX research and design, marketing, customer support, and legal teams to deliver value to customers swiftly and consistently. Learn rapidly from both quantitative and qualitative feedback, and adapt strategies with urgency based on these insights.
* Gain a thorough understanding of our extensive content offerings by engaging with our content professionals and in\-house genealogists, appreciating the depth and power of Ancestry’s content, which includes over 60 billion records.

**Who you are:**

* At least 6 years of experience delivering successful and innovative consumer products. Experience developing search or recommendation products is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated success in building data\-driven products at scale, serving millions of users, through effective collaboration with engineering teams.
* A passionate and creative problem\-solver who leverages data and customer insights to achieve business outcomes. Renowned for delivering elegant solutions to genuine user challenges.
* Exceptional skills in written communication, presentation, meeting management, and team\-building.
* Maintains high standards in all aspects—personal contributions, team collaborations, and product development. Driven by data, with the ability to independently gather the necessary information to make informed decisions. Experience with experimentation to evaluate the impact of feature and algorithmic updates, combined with strong user experience instincts.
* Thrives in a collaborative setting, measuring personal success by the effectiveness of the team, the respect of colleagues, and the satisfaction of customers, alongside quantifiable metrics.
* Bachelor’s degree is required; a background in STEM or computer science is a plus.


Helping people discover their story is at the heart of ours. Ancestry is the largest provider of family history and personal DNA testing, harnessing a powerful combination of information, science and technology to help people discover their family history and stories that were never possible before. title: Lead Product Manager
description:
IGN Entertainment, a division of Ziff Davis, Inc., is one of the world’s largest gaming and entertainment media platforms and the go\-to destination for fans to explore and celebrate games, film, TV, comics and much more. Across its 16 digital properties, IGN Entertainment reaches more than 490 million monthly users in 110 countries and engages with 85 million fans on social media. Its portfolio includes favorites such as IGN, Eurogamer, Digital Foundry, Rock Paper Shotgun, and MapGenie, delivering daily content across 46 platforms, including YouTube, TikTok, X, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, and connected TV. Through its online digital store Humble Bundle, IGN Entertainment has donated over $250 million to more than 38,000 charities worldwide, underscoring its commitment to making a positive impact. Headquartered in Los Angeles, IGN Entertainment's content is localized in 20 languages. Learn more at corp.ign.com.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


As a Lead Product Manager at IGNE, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring our products are not only usable and feasible but also valuable and viable. You'll collaborate closely with designers and engineers to shape the direction of our offerings. This individual contributor position offers the unique opportunity to contribute to our annual product strategy and quarterly objectives. Your ability to leverage data, sound logic, and a passionate drive will be instrumental in driving the success of our products.


We expect our Product Managers to bring a profound understanding of our users and customers, underpinned by data\-driven insights into customer engagement. Keeping a close eye on industry trends and the competitive landscape is also a core responsibility, ensuring that our products remain innovative. Additionally, you'll need to become well\-versed in navigating the intricacies of our business, considering factors such as editorial, sales, service, finance, legal, privacy, and social media.


Joining IGNE’s Product Team means tackling a substantial and diverse set of responsibilities. We frequently receive requests from collaborators in various departments of the company. Our cross\-functional team is tasked with striking a balance between long\-term, sustainable enhancements for our portfolio of sites and apps and shorter\-term revenue growth opportunities on a quarterly basis. To excel in this role, you'll need to be a dynamic relationship builder and able to prioritize, ensuring that we stay focused on what truly matters for the business, all under the supportive guidance of our Director of Product.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Product Strategy \- Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGNE's digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company's goals and objectives.
* Product Leadership \- Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
* Team Leadership \- Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high\-quality products.
* Product Roadmap \- Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data\-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
* User Research \- Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and struggles. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
* User Experience (UX) \- Work with UX/UI designers to create user\-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGNE's digital platforms.
* Data Analysis \- Use data analytics and key performance indicators to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data\-driven decisions to optimize the product.
* Product Development \- Oversee the end\-to\-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high\-quality products on schedule.
* Project Management \- Identify and prioritize product improvements, features, and needs using feedback from customers, research on the market, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
* Product Launch \- Plan and implement successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post\-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
* Stakeholder Communication \- Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, achievements, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
* Market and Competitive Analysis \- Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to find opportunities and threats in the market.
* User Feedback and Support \- Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

* Solid understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends.
* Proven track record of building intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs
* Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth
* Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction
* A history of deep, and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery.
* 5\-7 years working on technology\-powered products as either a product manager, product designer, engineer, data analyst, data scientist, or user researcher.
* Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well\-structured, data\-informed, written narrative.
* Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Deep understanding of gaming trends.
* Strong background in app development and design.

**Work Environment:**
---------------------

* **Work Schedule:** 40 hours per week, M\-F.
* **Travel Requirements:** No travel is required for this role.
* **Physical Requirements:** This role involves standard office\-based activities, including extended periods of sitting, standing, and working at a computer.
* **Work Model:** For applicants who reside in or around New York or Los Angeles, there will be a requirement to go into our offices, 2 to 3 days per week. For others located in different areas around the US, this position will be remote.

**Our Culture and Values**
--------------------------


At IGN, we believe diversity stimulates creativity, promotes the exchange of new ideas, and enriches our personal and professional lives. We are committed to championing diversity in all that we do, weaving fairness and equity into the fabric of our organization, and achieving a safe, welcoming, inclusive, and antiracist culture where everyone belongs and everyone can thrive.

**Here’s the good stuff about us…**
-----------------------------------

* **You’ll make an impact.** We reach 490MM monthly unique users. We’re big time, but we’re not afraid to give you real opportunities to be epic and make a difference immediately.
* **We’ve got a big presence, but a small team**.
* **We have fun.** It’s all about games and games are fun. Anyone can offer a casual work environment, flexible hours, and benefits. We can offer that and a place where you can squad up with your coworkers in the arcade/game room.
* **We’re passionate about what we do.** IGN employees understand our users, because they are our users. We have a personal interest in providing the best possible product.

**Why Join Us:**
----------------

* Join a forward\-thinking, distributed team in one of the most exciting sectors—gaming and entertainment.
* Work with innovative programmatic technologies and tools.
* Enjoy a collaborative and dynamic environment.


IGN Entertainment offers competitive salaries in addition to robust health and wellness focused benefits including medical, dental, vision, life and disability benefits; Flexible Spending accounts, 401(k) with company match, an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Pregnancy and Parental leave, Family Planning Support via Maven, Flexible Time Off, Volunteer Time Off, Fitness Reimbursement as well as employee\-focused engagement and education programs, including Employee Resource Groups and company\-sponsored events. If you’re seeking a dynamic work environment where you can see the direct impact of your performance, then IGN is the place for you.

title: Product Manager
description:
Description:

Join our winning team, recently honored as \#67 on Forbes’ list of America’s Best Startup Employers for 2024!

**The Helper Bees** (THB) was created to fill an obvious need in an underserved community. Inspired by love and brought to reality through passion and determination, The Helper Bees was founded to empower older adult citizens and their families in their search for quality, affordable in\-home care providers. We do this by providing older adults the ability to easily review, choose, and access affordable quality in\-home helpers.

  

The Helper Bees mission is to **help people stay home longer** through data\-driven services that transform both the payer and the care\-recipient experience.

  

At THB, we define our company culture through our Core Values:

* **Quickly iterate through solutions** \- We move at a fast pace which requires quick iterations to find a path to a repeatable solution
* **Seek ways to create immediate impact** \- Be thoughtful and proactive in how you make an impact on your team. Actively look for ways to make a fast, positive impact.
* **Bee the teammate you want to work with** \- We work as a team, help each other and encourage each other
* **Ask questions, answer questions** \- You can't iterate through solutions if you don't ask the right questions which is why there is an expectation that questions should be asked. When you know the answer, being a good teammate means chiming in to get others up to speed.
* **Take the time to celebrate wins** \- It's so easy for a team that is heads down to forget about all the great things they've accomplished. That's why we make it a priority to remind ourselves to create space to celebrate wins, big or small.

**Job Summary:**


As we scale our impact on seniors and their personal supporters, we need a Product Manager with deep experience who will work with seniors, nurses, insurance carriers, and our internal Operations team to help improve workflows, internal tools and dashboards, and the overall effectiveness of our product offerings.


This Product Manager will know that the focus isn't really on the product, that the focus actually begins and ends with the change we are creating in the lives of seniors, and their personal supporters. They will see the product, and all its tools, as the means to accomplish this impact; they will thrive on deep understanding, trying new things, and being wrong, and will succeed by making measurable changes in the lives of these seniors.


Further, this Product Manager will help us in the evolution of The Helper Bees to the empowered product team model and is comfortable, fluent, and patient with the challenges that come from evolving an organization.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**


None

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with senior product management and cross\-functional teams to identify and prioritize user needs and business objectives.
* This is not a classic “product owner”, “product backlog manager”, “dev team product person”, or “feature team backlog manager” role \- we are looking for someone who is experienced operating in an empowered product team
* Engage directly with the users \- the seniors and the people who personally support them
* Continually gathering qualitative and quantitative user feedback and using it to drive product optimizations and the evolution of the product strategy
* Build quick, iterative solutions to improve workflows for nurses, internal teams, and partner organizations, and have ways of measuring success
* Drill past the noise to understand the root cause of problems that impact multiple stakeholders, both internal and external
* Scale and productize at the right times, and have conclusive evidence and conviction for it
* Participating in defining the product strategy and product roadmap
* Proactively identifying strategic opportunities in the competitive market
* Continued familiarity with changes, and trends in the larger environment/market for relevant senior care
* Collaborating with launch efforts, and customizations, for new partners/clients
* Communicating with expertise in the product’s functions, features, and processes
* Hosting and performing product demos to stakeholders, both internal and external
* Performs other duties as assigned/necessary

**Performance Metrics:**

* Outcome\-Based Performance Metrics:
* User Satisfaction and Usability Metrics: Use tools like customer satisfaction surveys, Sean Ellis tests, and usability scores to directly measure the impact of work on the end\-user.
* Feature Usage and Adoption Rates: Measure how new features or updates are used and how quickly they are adopted by the target audience, reflecting the PM's ability to deliver valuable enhancements.
* Strategic Alignment Metrics:
* Alignment Score: Assesses how well the outcomes of the PM’s work align with the broader strategic goals of the company.
* This might include qualitative assessments from senior leadership.
* Flexibility and Adaptability Index: Rates the PM’s ability to adjust projects and priorities in response to shifting company strategies or market conditions.
* Customer Discovery Success Metrics:
* Customer Engagement Levels: Track the number of customer interactions per cycle (interviews, surveys, usability tests) to measure the PM’s dedication to understanding customer needs.
* Insight Implementation Rate: Measure the percentage of insights derived from customer discovery that are tested or implemented into the product development cycle


Requirements:
**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* **Process Skills and Techniques:**
* Product discovery techniques \- come to a strong understanding of the product risks, develop how to address each of them; how to tackle risks upfront, before development/delivery occurs, collaborative problem solving, focus on outcome, understand and utilize both qualitative and quantitative techniques
* Product optimization techniques \- knows how to utilize optimization techniques to rapidly improve and refine the products in use with seniors and their personal supporters
* Product delivery techniques \- understand responsibilities to the other team members involved in delivery, esp. developers, and product marketing
* Product development process \- has a solid understanding of the broader product\-development process including discovery and delivery, as well as administrative responsibilities
* **People Skills and Responsibilities:**
* Team collaboration skills \- works well with product developers and product designers, relationship is collaborative, with mutual respect; involves the product developers and product designers early and provides them direct access to customers; demonstrates and leads team in fully leveraging each team member's skills and minds
* Stakeholder collaboration skills \- collaborates well with stakeholders across The Helper Bees, to help them feel as if they have a true partner in Product that is genuinely committed to their success; established mutual respect and mutual trust with each stakeholder, including the senior leadership
* Evangelism skills \- shares the product's vision and product strategy, motivates and inspires the product team as well as the various stakeholders and others at The Helper Bees whose contributions are important to the product
* Leadership skills \- influences and inspires people with leadership skills, despite not having direct reports; an effective communicator and motivator; the team and stakeholders look to them for leadership, especially in stressful situations; strongly proactive, strong bias towards action (i.e. doesn’t wait for permission, take leaps and acts)
* Compassionate and inspiring \- able to effectively understand and be compassionate with the seniors we serve, as well as the personal supporters in their lives trying to help them age\-in\-place; able to inspire through their connection and the impact their product will create
* Critical thinking and effective communication \- develop strong and compelling arguments, e.g. interpersonal skills, play well with others, skilled in the written narrative, skilled at presenting
* Must be 18 years of age or older

**Education and Experience:**

* 3\-5 years of experience as a Product Manager, preferably in a collaborative team environment
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
* Experience in the healthcare industry is a plus!

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to remain at your designated workstation for the duration of the workday
* Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a phone and Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP).
* The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
* The ability to observe details at close range (typically on a computer screen)
* This position offers the flexibility of remote work at approved locations within the United States. Candidates must have a reliable internet connection and a designated work environment conducive to professional phone calls and sensitive data. Enjoy the convenience and comfort of working remotely while contributing to our team's success.

*The Helper Bees is committed to building a workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are valued and prioritized. We are an equal opportunity employer that welcomes all qualified applicants without discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any non\-merit based or legally protected grounds.*

The Helper Bees adheres to applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding these screenings, and the results will be considered in accordance with applicable regulations.*

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.



Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**



We're looking for an experienced Product Manager to help us take one of our largest and fastest growing businesses \- Video\-based Safety \- to the next level.



Join our Safety Workflows team and be a key driver in advancing our AI\-enabled dash camera's innovative safety features. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with our dedicated teams in Engineering and Design, as well as work cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Our ambitions for this product are high, and we're already making significant progress with our amazing team. Now, we're excited to invite you to join us!


**This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States.** **This position requires working hours in pacific timezone. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.**


**You should apply if:**


* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

* Work with our talented engineering teams to launch new software features, and hel
* Work with our talented engineering teams to launch new software features, and help drive a fast\-growing, at\-scale business with $1 Billion\+ in ARR.
* Partner with customers and shape the long\-term Safety roadmap, building the foundation for future business growth.
* Collaborate closely with customers to deeply understand their business, their product feedback and inform feature prioritization.
* Utilize data and insights to improve our customer experience and identify new product opportunities.
* Partner with our Sales team to help close strategic customer accounts as needed.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.


**Minimum requirements for the role:**


* 2\+ years in a product management or engineering role, with a deep understanding of how to operate \& deliver as a team.
* Ability to grasp technical concepts, and establish credibility with engineers.
* Bias\-to\-action and hands\-on experience delivering business results. You're not afraid to get your hands dirty writing a spec or jumping on a customer call, but can also mentor others to do the same.
* Excellent communication skills. Must be comfortable presenting to various audiences, from frontline workers to senior executives.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and deliver high quality product experiences on tight timelines and in line with our business aspirations.


**An ideal candidate also has:**


* Bachelors or Masters degree in a technical field; an MBA is a plus.
* Deep experience creating and growing products in a fast paced dynamic environment.

title: Senior Product Manager, Small Dollar Loans - Growth
description:
**About Upstart**



Upstart is the leading AI lending marketplace partnering with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit. By leveraging Upstart's AI marketplace, Upstart\-powered banks and credit unions can have higher approval rates and lower loss rates across races, ages, and genders, while simultaneously delivering the exceptional digital\-first lending experience their customers demand. More than 80% of borrowers are approved instantly, with zero documentation to upload.



Upstart is a digital\-first company, which means that most Upstarters live and work anywhere in the United States. However, we also have offices in San Mateo, California; Columbus, Ohio; and Austin, Texas.



Most Upstarters join us because they connect with our mission of enabling access to effortless credit based on true risk. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Upstart, we’d love to hear from you!


**The Team**



Upstart’s **Small Dollar Lending** team is on a mission to put technology to work for everyday Americans. Every year, millions of people turn to high\-cost payday and cash advance loans to cover short\-term needs, often paying excessive fees and interest to make ends meet. We’re looking for people who want to build products instead that help our customers stabilize their lives and build real financial security. We believe AI can be an agent for opportunity, that financial systems should serve people \- not the other way around \- and that we have a choice: to be part of the problem or to help finally change the game. Hint: we’re called Upstart for a reason.



As a **Senior Product Manager, SDL \- Growth**, you’ll define and execute our distribution strategy to drive organic adoption among the many Americans who otherwise rely on exploitative debt to manage urgent financial needs. Operating at the intersection of product and marketing, you’ll rapidly test, iterate, and embed growth levers directly into the product experience.


***Position Location \-*** This role is available in the following locations: Remote


***Time Zone Requirements \-*** This team operates on the East/West Coast time zones.


***Travel Requirements \-*** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time.


**How you’ll make an impact:**


* **Develop a deep understanding of our customers and design empathetic product experiences**: address our customers’ real\-world needs, meeting them where they are financially and personally.
* **Define and own our organic distribution strategy:** Identify the key channels, tactics, and in\-product features that naturally bring new users to our products and retain them without relying on heavy paid acquisition.
* **Work with engineering to embed growth levers:** Partner closely with developers to design, build, and test product capabilities (e.g. referrals, social sharing) that scale organic adoption.
* **Collaborate with marketing teams to support scalable, cost\-effective growth:** Work with lifecycle, partnerships, and other existing channels to expand reach while aligning with sustainable unit economics.
* **Use data to guide rapid iteration:** Analyze user behavior, funnel metrics, and unit economics to refine approaches quickly, doubling down on what’s effective while discarding what isn’t.


**What we’re looking for:**


* Minimum requirements:
	+ 4\+ years of product management experience, preferably in consumer software or growth. You’ve shipped great software before that delights the customers and delivers business results.
	+ Gets results. You have a track record of setting and delivering on ambitious goals.
	+ Strong technical abilities. You’ve written detailed requirements for engineering, including detailed process flows.
	+ Analytically rigorous. You bring structure and order to ambiguous problems. You write your own SQL queries and pull your own data. You’ve run or analyzed experiments yourself.
	+ Cross\-functional project management. You work seamlessly across marketing, product, engineering, and data / analytics teams. You keep the trains running and hit your target dates.
	+ Ownership and growth mindset. You act like an owner. You’re often right, but humble and open minded about being wrong. You’re perpetually dissatisfied and striving to improve yourself and the team.
* Preferred qualifications:
	+ Experience with marketing technology: Salesforce or other email / SMS platforms, customer data platforms
	+ Experience working with Machine Learning models, particularly uplift or attribution models
	+ Experience with sophisticated online experimentation
	+ Experience with 3rd party data integrations
  


**What you'll love:**


* Competitive Compensation (base \+ bonus \& equity)
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart

* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

* Supportive parental, family care, and military leave programs

* Social activities including team events and onsites, all\-company updates, employee resource groups (ERGs), and other interest groups such as book clubs, fitness, investing, and volunteering
* Catered lunches \+ snacks \& drinks when working in offices
